_doc: RADE manifest (contract: rhope-ops/RADE schemas/rade-manifest.schema.json). Built by the RADE engine through scripts/build_paste_bundles.py (a pinned shim, see scripts/rade.lock.json). Each bundle is one round: a self-contained PowerShell text the PFM copies from its raw page and pastes into Windows PowerShell ISE (F5). It writes the files, then opens RADE, the Redacted Application Deployment Engine (a window; text prompts if no window can open): steps run one by one with a live log and PASS/FAIL counts, then one results folder (Rounds\\<round>: a report file plus copies of the PDFs, to attach to one e-mail; zips do not cross the boundary) and a summary for the clipboard. It runs only the steps inside it (PFM 3A). A step's "default" may be {passed, paths}: the step is ticked only when those files changed since the round that passed it; after a round passes it, set passed to the new hash (PFM 14 Nov 26). Never hand-edit scripts/gov/paste/*.ps1: change this file or the sources and rebuild. A step may list "needs" (check ids in the engine's $checkDefs) and "estimate" (minutes, used until a real run time exists). "apps" is the embedded catalog the Choose screen lists (name, plain-English summary, step names); without it, one application has every step. A guide step may set "doneText" (its Done button) and "doneLog" (the log line on Done).

bundles.title: Round R26: the easy-path probe. Tries the easy ways for tests T2 to T10 of the 13-step process on the test site with fake data: file conversion, form filling, a Read-only person writing through an app, address-list search, mailbox members, 4 ways to send an e-mail (read back by a flow), and a signed PDF. One PASSED or FAILED line per test. Everything it makes on the site goes to the site Recycle Bin at the end

steps.name: T21 Make the probe list and library r1
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Makes the list "90161Z Probe" and the library "90161Z Probe Files", lets site visitors write to that list only, uploads 2 fake files, saves 1 fake PDF. About 2 minutes (estimate).
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.

steps.name: T21 Import the probe solution r1
steps.note: You import the solution "90-161.Z probe" and select Done. About 8 minutes (estimate).
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)
guide: 1. Select "Open in browser". Power Automate opens; sign in with your CAC if asked.
2. Select Solutions (under More if it is not shown), then Import solution > Browse.
3. In the File name box, press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard), select Open, then Next.
4. Connections: select your existing connection for SharePoint, Outlook, OneDrive, Office 365 Users and Office 365 Groups.
5. If a connector has no connection: select New connection > Create, sign in, return to the import tab and select Refresh.
6. Environment variables: "1 Site URL": paste the test site address. "3 Shared mailbox": type the PFM office mailbox address (not empty).
7. Keep all other values. Select Import and wait for "Successfully imported" (1 to 3 minutes, estimate).
8. Open the solution. The 3 flows "90161Z T21 Probe ..." must read On. If one reads Off, turn it on.
9. Return to RADE and select "Done: imported".
If the import fails: Select "Download log file", type the first red error line (no names) below, then select "It failed".
after: T21 Make the probe list and library r1
steps.help: Send the results as they are; the import log step reads the log if you downloaded it.

steps.name: T21 Import the Word solution r1
steps.note: You import the solution "90-161.Z probe Word" and select Done. The import may be refused on this tenant: a refusal is a valid result. About 4 minutes (estimate).
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)
guide: 1. Select "Open in browser". Power Automate opens; sign in with your CAC if asked.
2. Select Solutions (under More if it is not shown), then Import solution > Browse.
3. In the File name box, press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard), select Open, then Next.
4. Connections: select your existing connection for SharePoint; create one for Word Online (Business).
5. Word Online (Business) is a Premium connector. If the page says you have no licence for it, that is the refusal.
6. Environment variables: "1 Site URL": the test site address (it can be filled already).
7. Keep all other values. Select Import and wait for "Successfully imported" (1 to 3 minutes, estimate).
8. Open the solution. The flow "90161Z T21 Probe Word r1" must read On. If one reads Off, turn it on.
9. Return to RADE and select "Done: imported".
If the import is refused: that is a result. Select "Download log file", type the first red error line (no names) below, then select "It failed".
after: T21 Make the probe list and library r1
steps.help: Send the results as they are; the import log step reads the log if you downloaded it.

steps.name: T21 Import the Mail solution r1
steps.note: You import the solution "90-161.Z probe Mail" and select Done. The import may be refused on this tenant: a refusal is a valid result. About 4 minutes (estimate).
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)

steps.name: T17 Import log reader r2
steps.note: Runs only if an import failed: copies the error rows of an import log saved in the last 3 hours to T17, addresses masked. Otherwise it reports SKIPPED.

steps.name: T21 AI Builder look r1
steps.note: Test T6, way a. You look whether Power Automate offers an AI Builder action on this tenant, and answer 1 question. Nothing is saved. About 3 minutes (estimate).
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)
guide: 1. Select "Open in browser". In Power Automate select Create > Instant cloud flow > Skip (no name is needed).
2. Select the + under the trigger (or New step). In the search box type: AI Builder
3. Look for the action "Run a prompt" (older name: "Create text with GPT using a prompt").
4. If it is offered: select it, open its Prompt list, and look whether a prompt such as "Summarize text" can be chosen.
5. Close the browser tab without saving (select Leave if asked).
6. Return to RADE, select "Done: I looked" and answer the question.
If Power Automate does not open: select "It failed" and type what you see (no names or addresses).

answers.prompt: What did Power Automate offer for AI Builder?
choices: Run a prompt, and a prompt can be chosen
Run a prompt, but no prompt or an error

steps.name: T21 Run the flow tests r1
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Starts the probe flows and waits up to 14 minutes: file conversion (T3, T5), fields (T6), 4 test e-mails read back by a flow (T9). Do not open Outlook. About 15 minutes (estimate).
after: T21 Import the probe solution r1
steps.help: Send the results as they are. A FAILED line is a result of the probe, not a fault of the round.

steps.name: T21 Build the test app r1
steps.note: You make one blank canvas app and paste 6 small code blocks. A plain test screen, not a design. Microsoft has no supported import for an app built outside Power Apps. About 15 minutes (estimate).
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Apps US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-us-government): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, not confirmed on the device)
guide: 1. Open the code file: press Windows key + R, press Ctrl+V (the file path is on the clipboard), then Enter. Keep Notepad open.
2. Select "Open in browser". Power Apps opens; sign in with your CAC if asked.
3. Select Create > Blank app > Blank canvas app. Name: 90161Z T21 Probe r1. Format: Tablet. Select Create.
4. On the left select Data > Add data > SharePoint. Paste the test site address, tick "90161Z Probe" and "90161Z Probe Files", select Connect.
5. Select Add data again, type Office 365 Users, and select it.
6. On the left rail select Power Automate (under the three dots if it is not shown) > Add flow > "90161Z T21 Probe App r1".
7. In Notepad, copy block 1 (the lines between its 2 marker lines). In Tree view, right-click Screen1 and select Paste code.
8. Do step 7 again for blocks 2 to 6. If a block is refused: use the part "BY HAND" under that block in the file, then go on.
9. Select Insert > Edit form. Data source: "90161Z Probe". Keep the fields Title and Attachments. Drag the form to an empty place.
10. Select Save (Ctrl+S), then Publish > Publish this version.
11. Return to RADE, select "Done: app built" and answer the 2 questions.
If you cannot go on: type the block number and the first error line (no names) below, then select "It failed". The app steps are then skipped.
after: T21 Import the probe solution r1
steps.help: Send the results as they are; the error line tells the next build which block to fix.

answers.prompt: Which block numbers pasted as code with no error? For example 1 2 3 4 5 6. Type 0 for none.
About how many minutes did this step take?

steps.name: T21 App tests r1
steps.note: You use the test app: 2 buttons, 1 search, 1 look at the draft, and you sign 1 fake PDF and attach it. Tests T2, T4, T7, T8 and T10. About 10 minutes (estimate).
guide: 1. In Power Apps select Play (the triangle, top right, or F5).
2. Select the button "T4 a". A green line must say the row was written.
3. Select the button "T4 b, T7 b, T8". A line must say the flow started.
4. In the search box type the first 3 letters of any last name, then select "T7 a: search". The line under it shows counts only.
5. Look at the PDF viewer and at the image beside it. Remember which of them shows the fake draft.
6. In File Explorer open your OneDrive folder RADE\90-161.Z\T21 and open 90161Z-T21-fake-sign-r1.pdf.
7. In Acrobat select All tools > Use a certificate > Digitally sign, draw a box and sign with your CAC.
8. Save the signed file in the same folder with -signed at the end of its name.
9. In the app form: Title must read T10. Select "Attach file", choose the signed PDF, then select the button "T10: submit".
10. Return to RADE, select "Done: tested" and answer the 3 questions.
If a button shows a red line: go on with the next step, and type the button name and the first words in the last answer.
after: T21 Build the test app r1

answers.prompt: What showed the fake draft in the app?
Could you sign the fake PDF with your CAC and attach it?
Did a button show a red line? Type the button and the first words (no names or addresses), or none.

steps.name: T21 Second person r1
steps.note: Test T4. A second person with only Read on the test site opens the app and selects 2 buttons (about 5 minutes, estimate). If nobody is free today, select Skip: T4 is then not run.
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Apps US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-us-government): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, not confirmed on the device)
guide: 1. In Power Apps select Apps, select the three dots beside "90161Z T21 Probe r1", then Share.
2. Add the second person as User (not Co-owner), select Share, and send that person the app link (Details > Web link).
3. The person opens the link, selects Allow if asked, then selects the button "T4 a" and then the button "T4 b, T7 b, T8".
4. Ask what the lines said (written, started, or refused).
5. Return to RADE, select "Done: second person" and answer the question.
If the person cannot open the app: type the first line of what the person sees (no names) below, then select "It failed".
after: T21 Build the test app r1

answers.prompt: What did the second person see?

steps.name: T21 Read the app tests r1
steps.note: Signs in (CAC) and reads the rows the app and its flow wrote. One PASSED or FAILED line for T4, T7, T8 and T10: field names and counts only. About 3 minutes (estimate).
steps.help: Send the results as they are.

steps.name: T21 Remove the probe list and library r1
steps.note: Signs in (CAC). Moves the list "90161Z Probe" and the library "90161Z Probe Files" to the site Recycle Bin (restorable for 93 days). Removes nothing else. About 1 minute (estimate).
after: T21 Make the probe list and library r1
steps.help: Send the results as they are. The step can be run again.

steps.name: T21 Remove the probe solutions and app r1
steps.note: You delete what the round made outside the site: up to 3 solutions, 1 app and 1 OneDrive folder. About 4 minutes (estimate).
steps.url_source: Microsoft Learn, Power Automate US Government (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/us-govt): DoD maker portal; editable in the window, remembered in Config (agent value, PFM to confirm in R13)
guide: 1. Select "Open in browser". In Power Automate select Solutions.
2. For "90-161.Z probe", "90-161.Z probe Word" and "90-161.Z probe Mail", if listed: select the three dots > Delete from this environment.
3. In Power Apps select Apps, the three dots beside "90161Z T21 Probe r1", then Delete.
4. In OneDrive (web), delete the folder "90161Z-probe" if it is there.
5. In Outlook, delete the test e-mails whose subject starts with "[TEST] 90161Z T9" (up to 4).
6. Return to RADE and select "Done: removed".
If something does not delete: type its name and the first line of the message, then select "It failed".
